phase.objective: Make checked-in profiles and artifact manifests the exact production source of truth before adding more integration layers.
entryCriteria: H01 and H04 are merged on main.
The exact H01 validated head passed the full static and Android/package workflow.
Checked-in profile JSON and schemas pass current repository validation.
The phase makes no physical-device acceptance claim.
exitCriteria: Android production profile resolution loads validated packaged JSON rather than duplicating profile definitions in Kotlin.
Artifact publication, listing, and runtime consumption use one strict manifest contract.
Existing typed QEMU, profile, artifact-upload, guest, and Android tests remain green.
The phase packet, debt register, and next-phase candidates are re-evaluated from the implementation result.
